package cogent

import (
	"errors"
	"image"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"cogentcore.org/core/events"
	"cogentcore.org/core/events/key"
	"cogentcore.org/core/math32"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/app"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/command"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/execution"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/ui"
)

var (
	ErrManualConfig      = errors.New("cogent: invalid manual configuration or copied adapter")
	ErrManualUnsupported = errors.New("cogent: manual routing requires the offscreen driver")
	ErrManualBusy        = errors.New("cogent: concurrent or reentrant manual operation")
	ErrManualClosed      = errors.New("cogent: manual adapter or window closed")
	ErrManualStale       = errors.New("cogent: stale manual window or control incarnation")
	ErrManualLayout      = errors.New("cogent: target requires a current explicit frame")
	ErrManualDisabled    = errors.New("cogent: target is disabled or hidden by a modal")
)

// ManualFont is checked, detached font data. Name is a slash-separated local
// font filename; the digest is required. No ambient system font lookup occurs.
type ManualFont struct {
	Name, SHA256 string
	Data         []byte
}
type ManualConfig struct {
	Clock                                 *execution.ManualClock
	Executor                              *execution.Manual
	Fonts                                 []ManualFont
	Theme                                 ui.Theme
	Commands                              *command.Registry
	LogicalDPI                            float32
	EventCapacity, OwnerBatch, MaxWindows int
	MaxControls                           int // zero uses 4096; each window descriptor is checked before allocation.
}

// ManualInput either supplies physical coordinates or resolves a current target
// to its measured center. Keys still route through actual focus; targets never
// invoke a descriptor callback. Window incarnation is always required.
type ManualInput struct {
	Window            string
	WindowIncarnation uint64
	Target            string
	TargetIncarnation uint64
	Type              events.Types

history-v1/source/specs/grid-native.md.utf8:
# Managed grid adapter checkpoint

This specification adds `ui.DataGrid` to the portable Grid contract in grid.md.
It does not replace the Table/Tree extensions, implement editable cells, qualify
P 6 performance targets, or certify Windows/Linux or screen-reader workflows.

`Node.Grid` is required only on the DataGrid leaf. `GridChange(GridEvent)` is a
notification after an accepted owner-held selection or viewport transition;
the model has already changed. Reasons are `GridSelection` and `GridViewport`.
Refused and no-op requests produce no notification. Grid/source state belongs
to the caller and must be mutated on `Application.Do`/PostWait; source Refresh is
explicit. A Grid has one live binding across windows. A same-window node ID
remount retires its old incarnation; failed preparation restores the old binding.
Teardown does not reset or close caller-owned state.

Four clipped native panes render frozen/scrolling headers and frozen/scrolling
body cells. Header Y and frozen X stay fixed. The host is the only Tab stop;
pooled cell text and scrollbars cannot take keyboard focus. Arrow and PageUp/
PageDown navigation are supported. Home/End/modified variants, editable cells,
range selection, sorting headers and a double-click action are outside this
checkpoint. Tab/ShiftTab and modal Escape keep the existing managed behavior.
A left press captures an opaque current cell reference at MouseDown. MouseUp
cannot reinterpret a recycled slot. Owner delivery checks lifetime, binding,
modal/disabled scope and generation. Wheel input accumulates fractional logical
pixels independently on each axis, refuses nonfinite input and bounds a single
issued delta. Sliders use finite normalized ranges accounting for frozen/header
panes; they do not create a second independent scroll offset.

Grid dimensions are integer logical pixels via Core units.Px (DPI/96). Existing
Node Min sizes remain Dp. Shared rounded edges map logical coordinates to scene
pixels. Native policy caps configured materialization at 256 rows,64 columns,
4096 cells and 8 MiB snapshot text before widget allocation. Larger portable budgets
remain valid outside this adapter. Native materialized local row/header/column
dimensions are at most 65536 logical px and natural relative rectangle edges are
within±262144 logical px; scale must be finite, positive and≤32, producing edges
within±8388608 scene dots. These checks do not cap domain row counts or total
vertical scroll extents. Portable MaxInt dimensions can be refused natively.
Hidden oversized column definitions are checked if/when materialized. Pools
reuse active widgets and destroy surplus slots to release private shaped-text
caches, with no whole-source allocation.

Render/Position never read the source/model or invoke user callbacks. Completed
native rendering publishes clipped actual ContentBBox/TotalBBox geometry. A
changed actual content size/scale posts one checked immutable layout request to
the owner, independently of input eligibility. Queue refusal can retry at a
later actual frame. A model capacity refusal preserves state and reports once
per size request, without an invalidation loop; a different valid size can
recover. Pending/current-invalid geometry cannot activate a cell or be inspected.

`InspectGrid(a,model)` is owner-held and returns a detached GridInspection after
an accepted current frame. It exposes source stamp, viewport, full column count,
binding and cell incarnations, projection generation, monotonic completed-frame
count, scale, host bounds and bounded cell/header records. Bounds are actual
clipped scene pixels including modal origin. It refuses `ErrGridLayout` while
model/source/size/scale transitions are ahead of measurement, `ErrGridClosed`
after retirement, or `ErrGridBinding` for a foreign owner. It does not render,
dispatch, mutate, fetch Cell strings or allocate hidden cells.

The retained accessibility tree exposes a table, full row/column counts, bounded
visible rows/cells/column headers, absolute row/column index ranges and selected
cells. IDs encode gridID,rowKey,columnID rather than pool slots. Cell press uses
the accepted opaque reference and existing bridge generation/lifetime guards.
Cocoa table selectors return only current visible cells; hidden lookups return
nil. The in-process inspection adds detached row/column metadata. Inert native
selector fixtures prove these attributes without creating NSWindow; external
AX clients and human screen-reader operation remain separate runtime gates.

NewManual captures current grid geometry and dynamic cells without calling
callbacks directly. Actual pointer/key/wheel events route through Core scene
focus/modal handling and the grid host. Dynamic cell incarnations retire on
projection changes. A source inspection failure remains an explicit failure,
rather than being mislabeled pending layout. Desktop GUI, physical input,
external AX and performance acceptance are not proved by these offscreen checks.

"""Qualify an integrated native Grid snapshot, preserving each run separately."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--root', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, out = args.root.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
    from child_process import run_child
    from sdk_environment import child_environment

    def write(name, value):
        with (out / name).open('x') as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, indent=2)
            stream.write('\n')

    def inputs():
        names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=root).decode().split('\0')
        files = set()
        for name in names:
            path = root / name
            if not name or not path.is_file() or name.startswith(('docs/', 'specs/', 'prototypes/')):
                continue
            files.add(path)
        for name in ('ui', 'drivers/cogent'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / name).glob('*') if p.is_file())
        for name in ('upstream', 'typesetting'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / 'drivers/cogent/build' / name).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        return {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p) for p in sorted(files)}

    write('run-start.json', {'started_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()})
    before = inputs()
    write('inputs-before.json', before)
    env = child_environment()
    version = subprocess.check_output(['go', 'version'], env=env, text=True).strip()
    commands = [
        ('full-repository-check', ['sh', 'scripts/check.sh'], root),
        ('editor-race-build', ['go', 'build', '-race', '-o', str(out / 'editor'), '.'], root / 'examples/editor'),
        ('editor-desktop-smoke', [str(out / 'editor'), '-smoke'], out),
    ]
    checks = []
    for name, argv, cwd in commands:
        log = out / (name + '.log')
        failure, code = None, None
        try:
            with log.open('xb') as stream:
                check_env = child_environment(runtime=name.endswith('smoke'))
                # check.sh sources env.sh; give it the same declared cache as
                # the direct Go checks instead of silently compiling anew.
                check_env['VELLUM_CACHE_DIR'] = '/tmp/vellum-p0-cache'
                result = run_child(argv, cwd=cwd, env=check_env,
                                   stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   timeout=90 if name.endswith('smoke') else 1200)
            code = result.returncode
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            failure = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'error': str(error),
                       'timed_out': isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)}
        check = {'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': code,
                 'failure': failure, 'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': digest(log) if log.exists() else None}
        write(name + '-exit.json', check)
        checks.append(check)
        print(json.dumps({'check': name, 'exit_code': code, 'failure': failure}), flush=True)
        if code != 0:
            break
    after = inputs()
    write('inputs-after.json', after)
    passed = before == after and len(checks) == len(commands) and all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in checks)
    stages = []
    if passed:
        output = (out / 'editor-desktop-smoke.log').read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
        stages = [line.removeprefix('stage ') for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('stage ')]
        passed = len([line for line in output.splitlines() if line.startswith('EDITOR_SMOKE_PASS:')]) == 1
    report = {'event': 'vellum.grid.native.integration', 'base_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
              'go_version': version, 'verifier': {'path': str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'sha256': digest(Path(__file__).resolve())},
              'inputs_before': before, 'inputs_after': after, 'unchanged': before == after,
              'checks': checks, 'editor_stages': stages, 'result': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL',
              'scope': 'Integrated portable/native checks and unchanged independent editor Cocoa regression. Grid desktop rendering is qualified separately with a frozen private example harness; physical input, external AX and performance remain open.'}
    write('qualification.json', report)
    print(json.dumps({'result': report['result'], 'inputs': len(before), 'proof_sha256': digest(out / 'qualification.json')}))
    if not passed:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

package cogent

import (
	"errors"
	"image"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"cogentcore.org/core/events"
	"cogentcore.org/core/events/key"
	"cogentcore.org/core/math32"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/app"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/command"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/execution"
	"github.com/dshills/vellum/ui"
)

var (
	ErrManualConfig      = errors.New("cogent: invalid manual configuration or copied adapter")
	ErrManualUnsupported = errors.New("cogent: manual routing requires the offscreen driver")
	ErrManualBusy        = errors.New("cogent: concurrent or reentrant manual operation")
	ErrManualClosed      = errors.New("cogent: manual adapter or window closed")
	ErrManualStale       = errors.New("cogent: stale manual window or control incarnation")
	ErrManualLayout      = errors.New("cogent: target requires a current explicit frame")
	ErrManualDisabled    = errors.New("cogent: target is disabled or hidden by a modal")
)

// ManualFont is checked, detached font data. Name is a slash-separated local
// font filename; the digest is required. No ambient system font lookup occurs.
type ManualFont struct {
	Name, SHA256 string
	Data         []byte
}
type ManualConfig struct {
	Clock                                 *execution.ManualClock
	Executor                              *execution.Manual
	Fonts                                 []ManualFont
	Theme                                 ui.Theme
	Commands                              *command.Registry
	LogicalDPI                            float32
	EventCapacity, OwnerBatch, MaxWindows int
	MaxControls                           int // zero uses 4096; each window descriptor is checked before allocation.
}

// ManualInput either supplies physical coordinates or resolves a current target
// to its measured center. Keys still route through actual focus; targets never
// invoke a descriptor callback. Window incarnation is always required.
type ManualInput struct {
	Window            string
	WindowIncarnation uint64
	Target            string
	TargetIncarnation uint64
	Type              events.Types
	Rune              rune
	Code              key.Codes
	Modifiers         key.Modifiers
	Button            events.Buttons
	Position          image.Point
	Delta             math32.Vector2
}

type ManualElement struct {
	ID, Parent                          string
	Incarnation                         uint64
	Kind                                ui.Kind
	Name                                string
	Value                               any
	Enabled, Focused, Visible, Selected bool
	Selection                           [2]int // UTF-16 range; focus direction is preserved separately.
	TextFocus                           int
	Bounds                              image.Rectangle // actual scene pixels, including dialog scene origin.
}
type ManualWindowSnapshot struct {
	ID                                                      string
	Incarnation                                             uint64
	Grids                                                   []GridInspection
	Elements                                                []ManualElement
	FocusedID                                               string
	Frames                                                  uint64
	Now, NextPaint                                          time.Time
	Events, Timers                                          int
	Blocked, ReadyPaint, FuturePaint, Closed, LayoutPending bool
	Failure                                                 error
	DomainClosed, RetirementPending                         bool
}
type ManualSnapshot struct {
	Application app.PendingState
	Clock       execution.ClockReadiness
	Executor    execution.Snapshot
	Windows     []ManualWindowSnapshot // immutable application registration order.
	Closed      bool
	Failure     error
}
type ManualStepResult struct{ Events, OwnerCallbacks, Frames int }

// Manual owns actual offscreen managed windows. Methods have one dispatch
// owner and refuse concurrency/reentrancy; callbacks may call Application APIs,
// but must not call back into this adapter. Clock and executor remain caller
// owned and are never implicitly advanced/stepped/closed.
type Manual struct {
	self           *Manual
	busy           atomic.Bool
	closed         atomic.Bool
	implementation *manualImplementation
}

history-v3/source/specs/grid-native.md.utf8:
# Managed grid adapter checkpoint

This specification adds `ui.DataGrid` to the portable Grid contract in grid.md.
It does not replace the Table/Tree extensions, implement editable cells, qualify
P 6 performance targets, or certify Windows/Linux or screen-reader workflows.

`Node.Grid` is required only on the DataGrid leaf. `GridChange(GridEvent)` is a
notification after an accepted owner-held selection or viewport transition;
the model has already changed. Reasons are `GridSelection` and `GridViewport`.
Refused and no-op requests produce no notification. Grid/source state belongs
to the caller and must be mutated on `Application.Do`/PostWait; source Refresh is
explicit. A Grid has one live binding across windows. A same-window node ID
remount retires its old incarnation; failed preparation restores the old binding.
Teardown does not reset or close caller-owned state.

Four clipped native panes render frozen/scrolling headers and frozen/scrolling
body cells. Header Y and frozen X stay fixed. The host is the only Tab stop;
pooled cell text and scrollbars cannot take keyboard focus. Arrow and PageUp/
PageDown navigation are supported. Home/End/modified variants, editable cells,
range selection, sorting headers and a double-click action are outside this
checkpoint. Tab/ShiftTab and modal Escape keep the existing managed behavior.
A left press captures an opaque current cell reference, binding incarnation,
scale and clipped scene rectangles at MouseDown. MouseUp
cannot reinterpret a recycled slot or a moved/resized scene rectangle. Owner delivery checks lifetime, binding,
modal/disabled scope and generation. Wheel input accumulates fractional logical
pixels independently on each axis, refuses nonfinite input and bounds a single
issued delta. Sliders use finite normalized ranges accounting for frozen/header
panes; they do not create a second independent scroll offset.

Grid dimensions are integer logical pixels via Core units.Px (DPI/96). Existing
Node Min sizes remain Dp. Shared rounded edges map logical coordinates to scene
pixels. Native policy caps configured materialization at 256 rows,64 columns,
4096 cells and 8 MiB snapshot text before widget allocation. Larger portable budgets
remain valid outside this adapter. Native local viewport and materialized row/header/column
dimensions are at most 65536 logical px and natural relative rectangle edges are
within±262144 logical px; scale must be finite, positive and≤32, producing edges
within±8388608 scene dots. These checks do not cap domain row counts or total
vertical scroll extents. Portable MaxInt dimensions can be refused natively.
Hidden oversized column definitions are checked if/when materialized. Pools
reuse active widgets and destroy surplus slots to release private shaped-text
caches, with no whole-source allocation.

Render/Position never read the source/model or invoke user callbacks. Completed
native rendering publishes clipped actual ContentBBox/TotalBBox geometry. A
changed actual content size/scale posts one checked immutable layout request to
the owner, independently of input eligibility. Queue refusal can retry at a
later actual frame. A model capacity refusal preserves state and reports once
per size request, without an invalidation loop; a different valid size can
recover. Pending/current-invalid geometry cannot activate a cell or be inspected.

`InspectGrid(a,model)` is owner-held and returns a detached GridInspection after
an accepted current frame. It exposes source stamp, viewport, full column count,
binding and cell incarnations, projection generation, monotonic completed-frame
count, scale, host bounds and bounded cell/header records. Bounds are actual
clipped scene pixels including modal origin. It refuses `ErrGridLayout` while
model/source/size/scale transitions are ahead of measurement, `ErrGridClosed`
after retirement, or `ErrGridBinding` for a foreign owner. It does not render,
dispatch, mutate, fetch Cell strings or allocate hidden cells.

The retained accessibility tree exposes a table, full row/column counts, bounded
visible rows/cells/column headers, absolute row/column index ranges and selected
cells. IDs encode gridID,rowKey,columnID rather than pool slots. Cell press uses
the accepted opaque reference and existing bridge generation/lifetime guards.
The `grid:` Node.ID prefix is reserved across all managed descriptors for
generated cell, row and header identities, including nested/workbench/modal views.
Validation refuses ordinary descriptors with that prefix before native allocation,
without fetching hidden rows or cells. `GridCellID` may be used as a captured
dynamic input target; it must not be reused as a descriptor ID.
Cocoa table selectors return only current visible cells; hidden lookups return
nil. The in-process inspection adds detached row/column metadata. Inert native
selector fixtures prove these attributes without creating NSWindow; external
AX clients and human screen-reader operation remain separate runtime gates.

NewManual captures current grid geometry and dynamic cells without calling
callbacks directly. Actual pointer/key/wheel events route through Core scene
focus/modal handling and the grid host. Dynamic cell incarnations retire on
projection changes. A source inspection failure remains an explicit failure,
rather than being mislabeled pending layout. Desktop GUI, physical input,
external AX and performance acceptance are not proved by these offscreen checks.

"""Qualify the corrected integrated Grid and independent consumer sources."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--root', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, out = args.root.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
    from child_process import run_child
    from sdk_environment import child_environment

    def write(name, value):
        (out / name).write_bytes((json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n').encode())

    def inputs():
        names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=root).decode().split('\0')
        files = set()
        for name in names:
            path = root / name
            if name and path.is_file() and not name.startswith(('docs/', 'specs/', 'prototypes/')):
                files.add(path)
        for name in ('ui', 'drivers/cogent', 'examples/grid'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / name).glob('*') if p.is_file())
        for name in ('upstream', 'typesetting'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / 'drivers/cogent/build' / name).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        return {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p) for p in sorted(files)}

    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    before = inputs()
    write('inputs-before.json', before)
    commands = [
        ('ui-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', './ui'], root, 600),
        ('driver-offscreen-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('driver-default-vet', ['go', 'vet', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('driver-offscreen-vet', ['go', 'vet', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('independent-example-check', ['sh', 'scripts/check-example.sh'], root, 600),
        ('grid-offscreen-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-offscreen-vet', ['go', 'vet', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-race-build', ['go', 'build', '-race', '-o', str(out / 'grid'), '.'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-desktop-smoke', [str(out / 'grid'), '-smoke'], out, 90),
        ('editor-race-build', ['go', 'build', '-race', '-o', str(out / 'editor'), '.'], root / 'examples/editor', 600),
        ('editor-desktop-smoke', [str(out / 'editor'), '-smoke'], out, 90),
    ]
    checks = []
    for name, argv, cwd, timeout in commands:
        log = out / (name + '.log')
        failure, code = None, None
        try:
            with log.open('xb') as stream:
                env = child_environment(runtime=name.endswith('smoke'))
                env['VELLUM_CACHE_DIR'] = '/tmp/vellum-p0-cache'
                completed = run_child(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                      stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            code = completed.returncode
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            failure = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'error': str(error),
                       'timed_out': isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)}
        check = {'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': code,
                 'failure': failure, 'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': digest(log) if log.exists() else None}
        write(name + '-exit.json', check)
        checks.append(check)
        print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'exit_code': code, 'failure': failure}), flush=True)
        if code != 0:
            break
    after = inputs()
    write('inputs-after.json', after)
    passed = before == after and len(checks) == len(commands) and all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in checks)
    grid_stages, editor_stages = [], []
    if passed:
        for line in (out / 'grid-desktop-smoke.log').read_bytes().decode().splitlines():
            try:
                value = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('stage') in {'ready', 'far-both-axes', 'immutable-projection', 'pass'}:
                grid_stages.append(value)
        editor_text = (out / 'editor-desktop-smoke.log').read_bytes().decode()
        editor_stages = [line.removeprefix('stage ') for line in editor_text.splitlines() if line.startswith('stage ')]
        passed = ([x['stage'] for x in grid_stages] == ['ready', 'far-both-axes', 'immutable-projection', 'pass']
                  and len([x for x in editor_text.splitlines() if x.startswith('EDITOR_SMOKE_PASS:')]) == 1)
    proof = {'event': 'vellum.grid.final.integration',
             'started_utc': started,
             'base_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
             'go_version': subprocess.check_output(['go', 'version'], env=child_environment(), text=True).strip(),
             'verifier': {'path': str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'sha256': digest(Path(__file__).resolve())},
             'inputs_before': before, 'inputs_after': after, 'unchanged': before == after,
             'checks': checks, 'grid_stages': grid_stages, 'editor_stages': editor_stages,
             'binaries': {name: digest(out / name) for name in ('grid', 'editor') if (out / name).exists()},
             'result': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL',
             'scope': 'Corrected native adapter with repository-relative consumer modules, actual offscreen routing and sequential Cocoa Grid/editor smoke. Grid smoke uses owner commands, not physical input. Previous full v3 repository qualification remains historical; performance/external AX/human workflows remain open.'}
    write('qualification.json', proof)
    print(json.dumps({'result': proof['result'], 'inputs': len(before), 'proof_sha256': digest(out / 'qualification.json')}))
    if not passed:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Promote exact reviewed Grid bytes in two separately committed phases."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git(root, *arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *arguments], cwd=root)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--source', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--destination', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--ledger', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--ledger-sha256', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--metadata', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--metadata-sha256', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source, dest = args.source.resolve(), args.destination.resolve()
    ledger_path = source / args.ledger
    assert digest(ledger_path) == args.ledger_sha256
    assert digest(args.metadata) == args.metadata_sha256
    ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_bytes())
    metadata = json.loads(args.metadata.read_bytes())
    assert metadata['result'] == 'APPROVED'
    assert metadata['ledger_sha256'] == args.ledger_sha256
    assert git(dest, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == ledger['base_commit']
    assert not git(dest, 'status', '--porcelain', '-z'), 'Canonical changes require integration before promotion'
    hashes = {**ledger['files'], args.ledger: args.ledger_sha256}
    phases = {name: list(paths) for name, paths in ledger['phases'].items()}
    phases['native'].append(args.ledger)
    assert set(phases) == {'native', 'example'}
    assert not (set(phases['native']) & set(phases['example']))
    assert set(phases['native']) | set(phases['example']) == set(hashes)
    staged = set(filter(None, git(source, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z').decode().split('\0')))
    assert staged == set(hashes)
    for name, sha in hashes.items():
        assert digest(source / name) == sha
        assert hashlib.sha256(git(source, 'show', ':' + name)).hexdigest() == sha
    # Complete all byte copies before committing; no generated evidence enters
    # the native source without the same reviewed/qualified hash checks.
    for name, sha in hashes.items():
        path = dest / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source / name, path)
        assert digest(path) == sha
    commits = {}
    for phase, message in [('native', 'Add managed native data grid adapter'),
                           ('example', 'Add independent managed grid application')]:
        paths = phases[phase]
        subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '--', *paths], cwd=dest, check=True)
        actual = set(filter(None, git(dest, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z').decode().split('\0')))
        assert actual == set(paths)
        for name in paths:
            assert hashlib.sha256(git(dest, 'show', ':' + name)).hexdigest() == hashes[name]
        subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'], cwd=dest, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'commit', '-m', message], cwd=dest, check=True)
        commits[phase] = git(dest, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip()
    assert not git(dest, 'status', '--porcelain', '-z')
    print(json.dumps({'commits': commits, 'files': len(hashes), 'canonical_clean': True,
                      'ledger_sha256': args.ledger_sha256,
                      'metadata_sha256': args.metadata_sha256}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Qualify the corrected integrated Grid and independent consumer sources."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--root', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--previous', type=Path, help='retain passed adapter checks when only example sources changed')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, out = args.root.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
    from child_process import run_child
    from sdk_environment import child_environment

    def write(name, value):
        (out / name).write_bytes((json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n').encode())

    def inputs():
        names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=root).decode().split('\0')
        files = set()
        for name in names:
            path = root / name
            if name and path.is_file() and not name.startswith(('docs/', 'specs/', 'prototypes/')):
                files.add(path)
        for name in ('ui', 'drivers/cogent', 'examples/grid'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / name).glob('*') if p.is_file())
        for name in ('upstream', 'typesetting'):
            files.update(p for p in (root / 'drivers/cogent/build' / name).rglob('*') if p.is_file())
        return {str(p.relative_to(root)): digest(p) for p in sorted(files)}

    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    before = inputs()
    write('inputs-before.json', before)
    commands = [
        ('ui-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', './ui'], root, 600),
        ('driver-offscreen-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('driver-default-vet', ['go', 'vet', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('driver-offscreen-vet', ['go', 'vet', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'drivers/cogent', 600),
        ('independent-example-check', ['sh', 'scripts/check-example.sh'], root, 600),
        ('grid-offscreen-race', ['go', 'test', '-race', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-offscreen-vet', ['go', 'vet', '-tags', 'offscreen', './...'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-race-build', ['go', 'build', '-race', '-o', str(out / 'grid'), '.'], root / 'examples/grid', 600),
        ('grid-desktop-smoke', [str(out / 'grid'), '-smoke'], out, 90),
        ('editor-race-build', ['go', 'build', '-race', '-o', str(out / 'editor'), '.'], root / 'examples/editor', 600),
        ('editor-desktop-smoke', [str(out / 'editor'), '-smoke'], out, 90),
    ]
    checks = []
    inherited = None
    if args.previous:
        previous_path = args.previous.resolve()
        previous = json.loads(previous_path.read_bytes())
        assert previous['unchanged'] and previous['inputs_before'] == previous['inputs_after']
        previous_inputs = previous['inputs_after']
        changed = {name for name in before.keys() | previous_inputs.keys()
                   if before.get(name) != previous_inputs.get(name)}
        # Root README is an overview, outside the Go/native compile graph.
        # The check/build scripts and every other effective input must match.
        assert changed and all(name.startswith('examples/grid/') or name == 'README.md' for name in changed), changed
        retained = {name for name, *_ in commands[:4]}
        for check in previous['checks']:
            if check['name'] in retained:
                assert check['exit_code'] == 0 and check['failure'] is None
                assert digest(Path(check['log'])) == check['log_sha256']
                expected = next(c for c in commands if c[0] == check['name'])
                assert check['argv'] == expected[1] and check['cwd'] == str(expected[2])
                checks.append(check)
        assert {c['name'] for c in checks} == retained
        inherited = {'proof_path': str(previous_path), 'proof_sha256': digest(previous_path),
                     'previous_result': previous['result'], 'retained_checks': sorted(retained),
                     'changed_example_inputs': sorted(x for x in changed if x.startswith('examples/grid/')),
                     'changed_document_inputs': sorted(changed & {'README.md'}),
                     'scope': 'Earlier run failed only at consumer desktop smoke; passed adapter checks retained because all other effective source/resource bytes are unchanged.'}
        commands = commands[4:]
    expected_checks = len(checks) + len(commands)
    for name, argv, cwd, timeout in commands:
        log = out / (name + '.log')
        failure, code = None, None
        try:
            with log.open('xb') as stream:
                env = child_environment(runtime=name.endswith('smoke'))
                env['VELLUM_CACHE_DIR'] = '/tmp/vellum-p0-cache'
                completed = run_child(argv, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                      stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
            code = completed.returncode
        except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
            failure = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'error': str(error),
                       'timed_out': isinstance(error, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)}
        check = {'name': name, 'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_code': code,
                 'failure': failure, 'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': digest(log) if log.exists() else None}
        write(name + '-exit.json', check)
        checks.append(check)
        print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'exit_code': code, 'failure': failure}), flush=True)
        if code != 0:
            break
    after = inputs()
    write('inputs-after.json', after)
    passed = before == after and len(checks) == expected_checks and all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in checks)
    grid_stages, editor_stages = [], []
    if passed:
        for line in (out / 'grid-desktop-smoke.log').read_bytes().decode().splitlines():
            try:
                value = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if isinstance(value, dict) and value.get('stage') in {'ready', 'far-both-axes', 'immutable-projection', 'pass'}:
                grid_stages.append(value)
        editor_text = (out / 'editor-desktop-smoke.log').read_bytes().decode()
        editor_stages = [line.removeprefix('stage ') for line in editor_text.splitlines() if line.startswith('stage ')]
        passed = ([x['stage'] for x in grid_stages] == ['ready', 'far-both-axes', 'immutable-projection', 'pass']
                  and len([x for x in editor_text.splitlines() if x.startswith('EDITOR_SMOKE_PASS:')]) == 1)
    proof = {'event': 'vellum.grid.final.integration',
             'started_utc': started,
             'base_commit': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
             'go_version': subprocess.check_output(['go', 'version'], env=child_environment(), text=True).strip(),
             'verifier': {'path': str(Path(__file__).resolve()), 'sha256': digest(Path(__file__).resolve())},
             'inputs_before': before, 'inputs_after': after, 'unchanged': before == after,
             'checks': checks, 'grid_stages': grid_stages, 'editor_stages': editor_stages,
             'inherited_adapter_checks': inherited,
             'binaries': {name: digest(out / name) for name in ('grid', 'editor') if (out / name).exists()},
             'result': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL',
             'scope': 'Corrected native adapter with repository-relative consumer modules, actual offscreen routing and sequential Cocoa Grid/editor smoke. Grid smoke uses owner commands, not physical input. Previous full v3 repository qualification remains historical; performance/external AX/human workflows remain open.'}
    write('qualification.json', proof)
    print(json.dumps({'result': proof['result'], 'inputs': len(before), 'proof_sha256': digest(out / 'qualification.json')}))
    if not passed:
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
